label: AgMsv_1.152
cite_parts:
bhūtabhāvisvabhāvābhyāṃ sā hi yāti vibhāgitām /
tad asmin saṃvidavadhau viśramya tuṭimātrakam // [AgMsv_1.152]
quick_english: Time is divided by past and future; therefore, having rested in this limit of consciousness, one abides in a mere instant.

tokens.grounds: refers to time/tuṭi or consciousness-division in context
locative, refers to the limit of consciousness
absolutive, resting in the limit of awareness
accusative object, a bare moment of time

label: AgMsv_1.153
cite_parts:
kālagrāsaparo yogī jāyate khecaraḥ kṣaṇāt /
uktaṃ hi bhāvābhāso yaḥ kālaḥ sa kalanātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.153]
quick_english: The yogin devoted to devouring time becomes a sky-mover in an instant; for time is the appearance of things, and that is of the nature of limitation.

tokens.grounds: one who moves in the void of consciousness

label: AgMsv_1.154
cite_parts:
svasaṃvidraśmisaṃsphāro bhāvābhāvaḥ sa nāparaḥ /
tasmāt svaraśmisaṃrodhadvāraruddhādhvamaṇḍalaḥ // [AgMsv_1.154]
quick_english: Being and nonbeing are nothing other than the expansion of the rays of one's own consciousness; therefore, by stopping one's own rays, the whole sphere of paths is blocked.

tokens.grounds: compound bhāva-abhāva, the play of manifestation

label: AgMsv_1.155
cite_parts:
kālagrāsaikarasiko jāyate khecaraḥ svayam /
tad uktaṃ parameśena tantre śrīḍāmarābhidhe // [AgMsv_1.155]
quick_english: One who solely relishes the devouring of time becomes a sky-mover by himself; this is said by the Supreme Lord in the tantra called Śrīḍāmara.

tokens.grounds: compound śrī-ḍāmara-abhidha, name of the tantra

label: AgMsv_1.156
cite_parts:
niruddhya raśmicakraṃ svaṃ pītvāmṛtam anuttamam /
kālobhayāparicchinne vartamāne sukhī bhavet // [AgMsv_1.156]
quick_english: Having restrained one's own circle of rays and drunk the unsurpassed nectar, one becomes happy in the present that is not limited by time or by both its extremes.

tokens.grounds: absolutive, act of stopping the rays
compound raśmi-cakra, the radiance of consciousness
compound kāla-ubhaya-aparicchinna, locative of the present
present participle used as locative noun

label: AgMsv_1.157
cite_parts:
rodho 'pi nāma naitasmin saṃkocaparivarjite /
tadabhāvān na visphāro grāsatṛptī tathātra ke // [AgMsv_1.157]
quick_english: Even restraint does not truly exist in that state free from contraction; and because of that absence, expansion does not exist either—so how could devouring and satisfaction exist there?

tokens.grounds: compound saṃkoca-parivarjita, describes the absolute state

label: AgMsv_1.158
cite_parts:
kiṃ tūktanītyā saṃrodhasphāragrāsādi bhāsate /
na tathābhāsanāc cānyad vastu viśvatra kiṃ cana // [AgMsv_1.158]
quick_english: But by the method already described, restraint, expansion, devouring, and the rest do appear; yet from such appearance no other thing exists anywhere in the universe.

label: AgMsv_1.159
cite_parts:
ity alaṃ khecarīcakragoṣṭhyālāpena bhūyasā /
ko vābhinavagupte 'smin yogaḥ saṃvedanakrame // [AgMsv_1.159]
quick_english: Thus, enough of this extensive talk about the assembly of the khecarī circle; for in this teaching of Abhinavagupta, what yoga is there apart from the process of awareness?

tokens.grounds: vā + Abhinavagupta, locative of the author/self-reference

label: AgMsv_1.160
cite_parts:
prakṛtaṃ brūmahe devīvisṛṣṭāś citrasaṃvidaḥ /
yāvat tāvad tad ūrdhvordhvaṃ sroto yad bhedavarjitam // [AgMsv_1.160]
quick_english: Let us return to the topic: as far as the variegated consciousnesses emitted by the Goddess extend, so far above them is that higher and higher stream which is free from division.

tokens.grounds: accusative object, what was being discussed
compound devī-visṛṣṭa with elided nominative plural ending

label: AgMsv_1.161
cite_parts:
saurabhargaśikhādīni tataḥ śāstrāṇi tenire /
uktaṃ bhargaśikhāyāṃ ca devena parameṣṭhinā // [AgMsv_1.161]
quick_english: From that stream arose scriptures such as the Saura and the Bhargaśikhā; and this is said in the Bhargaśikhā by the Supreme Lord.

tokens.grounds: compound naming scriptures beginning with Bhargaśikhā

label: AgMsv_1.162
cite_parts:
ūrdhvasrotodbhavaṃ jñānam idaṃ tat paramaṃ priye /
paramadhvaninordhvordhvasaṃvidrūpābhidhāyinā // [AgMsv_1.162]
quick_english: ‘O beloved, this knowledge born of the upper stream is that supreme knowledge’—so it is taught by that which expresses higher and higher forms of consciousness on the supreme path.

tokens.grounds: vocative address in the cited scripture

label: AgMsv_1.163
cite_parts:
īśānavaktraniryātāt siddhāntād bhedam ādiśat /
atrāpi pūrvabhedāṃśavyāmiśrībhāvacitritāḥ // [AgMsv_1.163]
quick_english: It indicated a distinction from the Siddhānta issued from the face of Īśāna; and even here there are variegations produced by the unmixed aspects of earlier divisions.

tokens.grounds: ablative, the dualist Śaiva scripture stream

label: AgMsv_1.164
cite_parts:
vijñānasaṃpadas tāṃs tāṃs tanvate śāstravibhramān /
iha yāvat tu mukhyeyaṃ ṣaḍātmā śāstrasaṃtatiḥ // [AgMsv_1.164]
quick_english: Those various treasures of knowledge extend into diverse scriptural manifestations; but here the chief lineage of scriptures is sixfold in nature.

label: AgMsv_1.165
cite_parts:
etatpūrvārdhabhāgīni trikaśāstrāṇi yāni tu /
ṣaḍardhasaṃjñayā tāni gurubhir bhāṣitāny alam // [AgMsv_1.165]
quick_english: Those Trika scriptures that belong to the first half of this lineage are the ones the teachers have clearly spoken of under the name Ṣaḍardha.

tokens.grounds: past passive participle with elided nominative plural ending

label: AgMsv_1.166
cite_parts:
na tu gūḍharahasyatvād evaiṣa vacanakramaḥ /
evaṃ hi dvādaśārdhārdham ityādy api na kiṃ bhavet // [AgMsv_1.166]
quick_english: But this mode of expression is not used merely because the doctrine is deeply secret; for in that case, why could one not also say ‘half of half of twelve’ and so on?

label: AgMsv_1.167
cite_parts:
atra śaktitrayaṃ mukhyaṃ saṃpūrṇasthiti kalpate /
ananyonyoparodhena pūrṇaṃ pūrṇacidātmakam // [AgMsv_1.167]
quick_english: Here the triad of powers is primary; it constitutes a complete abiding without mutual obstruction, full and of the nature of full consciousness.

label: AgMsv_1.168
cite_parts:
tataḥ paraṃ tu tritayaṃ kasyāṃcid guṇitājuṣi /
anyasyāṃ guṇatābhāji yāmalaṃ paribhāṣyate // [AgMsv_1.168]
quick_english: Beyond that, when in one power the triad takes on subordination and in another it partakes of subordination, that configuration is described as the yāmala.

tokens.grounds: subject, the same triad in another mode
locative of an indefinite feminine referent (power)
compound guṇitā-juṣ, taking the role of a secondary quality

label: AgMsv_1.169
cite_parts:
paścād visṛṣṭe 'rthaughe tadvaicitryopādhiyogataḥ /
pṛthagbhāvaviyogāsu svātmaśaktiṣu pañcasu // [AgMsv_1.169]
quick_english: Afterward, when the mass of objects has been emitted, through connection with the conditions of its variegation it appears in the five powers of one's own self, which are not divided into separate beings.

tokens.grounds: artha-ogha with elided a, locative absolute

label: AgMsv_1.170
cite_parts:
citspandecchāvidākarmarūpāsu svaucitīvaśāt /
pañcabrahmāṅgasubhagāt sphuradbhāvāṃśabodhajam // [AgMsv_1.170]
quick_english: In those five powers whose forms are consciousness, vibration, will, knowledge, and action, by the force of their own appropriateness and through the grace of the five Brahman-limbs, there arises what is born from the awareness of the flashing aspects of being.

label: AgMsv_1.171
cite_parts:
rūpaṃ śāstrātmatāṃ prāptaṃ pañcadhaiva vijṛmbhate /
tathā hi prāg anantāntaḥsthitabhāvaughajṛmbhaṇam // [AgMsv_1.171]
quick_english: That form, having attained the nature of scripture, unfolds indeed in a fivefold way; for first there is the unfolding of the mass of beings situated within Ananta.

tokens.grounds: temporal adverb, at the prior stage

label: AgMsv_1.172
cite_parts:
yāvat karoti bhagavāṃs tāvad īśamukhasthitiḥ /
antaḥsthāyā abhinnāyāḥ kriyāśakter vijṛmbhaṇe // [AgMsv_1.172]
quick_english: As long as the Lord brings about that unfolding, there is abiding in the face of Īśa, in the unfolding of the inward, undivided power of action.

label: AgMsv_1.173
cite_parts:
kramād unmiṣite tāvān eṣa sphāraḥ pratāyate /
kriyāśakteḥ sphuṭaḥ sphāro māyātvaṃ pratipatsyate // [AgMsv_1.173]
quick_english: As it opens gradually, this expansion extends; and when the expansion of the power of action becomes clear, it will attain the state of māyā.

label: AgMsv_1.174
cite_parts:
māyātattvasvarūpe hi śiveśānīti vakṣyate /
śuddhaśuddhetarāśuddhaviśvanirmāṇakāriṇaḥ // [AgMsv_1.174]
quick_english: In the own form of maya-tattva, it will be said of shiva and ishani as makers of pure, pure-other, impure universes.

label: AgMsv_1.175
cite_parts:
pañcamantratanoḥ śambhor nirmeyāśuddhasaṃgatiḥ /
asty eva pūrvakoṭyāṃ hi sarvam eva vyavasthitam // [AgMsv_1.175]
quick_english: For the five-mantra-bodied shambhu, measurable impure association exists; indeed all is established at the prior extreme.

label: AgMsv_1.176
cite_parts:
tathā hi svagṛhāt kvāpi yiyāsoḥ prathamakṣaṇe /
yāvat kiṃ cana gantavyaṃ yac ca tanmadhyavṛtti tu // [AgMsv_1.176]
quick_english: Thus, for one wishing to go somewhere from his own house, at the first moment, whatever is to be gone, and the middle course, but.

label: AgMsv_1.177
cite_parts:
tuṭipāte 'pi sarvajñasarvakartṛtvalabdhṛtā /
tata eva viśeṣāṃśaniṣkampakuśalātmanām // [AgMsv_1.177]
quick_english: Even at an instant's fall, all-knowing all-making power is gained from that for the steady skillful selves of special parts.

label: AgMsv_1.178
cite_parts:
tathā hi jātyakhaḍgāgradhārāsaṃsparśasaṃmitā /
sphurattvasamakālaṃ dhīr viśeṣāṃśān prakarṣati // [AgMsv_1.178]
quick_english: Thus, measured by birth-sword-edge touch, at the same time as shining, intellect draws forth special parts.

label: AgMsv_1.179
cite_parts:
ratnatattvasphuṭaprajño vidyuttatkāladarśitān /
tāṃs tān viśeṣāṃś cinute ratnānāṃ bhūyasām api // [AgMsv_1.179]
quick_english: The clear knower of jewel-tattva gathers those special parts seen like lightning, even among many jewels.

label: AgMsv_1.180
cite_parts:
anekasvarasaṃbhārasparśalāghavayojite /
vīṇāyām ekavistāre vaicitryaṃ vetti tanmayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.180]
quick_english: In the vina joined with many sound-material touches, variety is known in one expansion by one made of that.

label: AgMsv_1.181
cite_parts:
nibiḍābhyāsadhārāgraviśrāntaśravaṇendriyaḥ /
vetty eva tatsvarāṃśāntaḥśrutyūnādhikatām api // [AgMsv_1.181]
quick_english: The hearing sense rested at the tip of dense practice stream indeed knows even that sound-part inner hearing less-more-ness.

label: AgMsv_1.182
cite_parts:
āstām abhedavāde 'sminn ayatnenaiva siddhyati /
etad yatra vibhāte 'pi bhede vāstavam advayam // [AgMsv_1.182]
quick_english: Let it be; in this nondifference doctrine, this succeeds effortlessly, where even in difference shining real nondual.

label: AgMsv_1.183
cite_parts:
bhedaikajīvite śāstre yāvad etad sthitaṃ sphuṭam /
tathā hi pātañjalinā pāde vaibhūtanāmani // [AgMsv_1.183]
quick_english: In difference-only-living scripture, this is clearly stood; for by Patanjali in the pada named powers.

label: AgMsv_1.184
cite_parts:
nyarūpyata `prātibhād vā sarvam' atra mayāpi ca /
prātibhe prathamonmeṣe saṃvidrūpiṇy akhaṇḍite // [AgMsv_1.184]
quick_english: It was formed, 'from intuition or all'; here by me too, in intuition at first opening, consciousness-formed undivided.

label: AgMsv_1.185
cite_parts:
sthitaḥ sarvasphurattātmā sarvasiddhiphalodayaḥ /
evaṃ jagati nirmeye nirmitsāsvīkṛtaṃ balāt // [AgMsv_1.185]
quick_english: Thus the all-shining self, source of all accomplishment, stands in the created world, where creation is accepted by force.

label: AgMsv_1.186
cite_parts:
aśuddham api tadrūpanānāvaicitryayogy api /
sāmānyākārarūpeṇa dalaṃ bhedātmasundaram // [AgMsv_1.186]
quick_english: Even impurity, fit for varied forms of that shape, appears in common form as a part beautiful as difference-self.

label: AgMsv_1.187
cite_parts:
āste pronmiṣitaṃ saiṣā bhedābhedātmikā sthitiḥ /
ata eva hi sādākhye jñānaśaktisvarūpiṇi // [AgMsv_1.187]
quick_english: This difference-nondifference state stands bloomed; therefore it is in sadākhya, the nature of knowledge-power.

label: AgMsv_1.188
cite_parts:
aśuddhileśakāluṣyāt parāparatayā sthitiḥ /
teneśabhuktād etasmād apy ūrdhvapadabhāginaḥ // [AgMsv_1.188]
quick_english: From impurity-particle-stain, state becomes higher-lower; even those reaching higher station arise from what is enjoyed by the lord.

label: AgMsv_1.189
cite_parts:
māyāprakaṭanautsukyāt tatsaṃskārajuṣas tathā /
bahukriyāsamārambhamayaṃ vividhamantraṇam // [AgMsv_1.189]
quick_english: From eagerness to manifest māyā, those enjoying its impressions thus receive various counsel full of many action-beginnings.

label: AgMsv_1.190
cite_parts:
prādurbhūtaṃ mahājñānasantateś ca śivapradam /
sa hi tatrāparo bhāvaḥ parabhāvanimīlitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.190]
quick_english: Manifested from the great knowledge continuum and giving śiva, that state is there; another state is merged in the supreme state.

label: AgMsv_1.191
cite_parts:
na tu rūḍhim upāgacched aśuddhordhvavidhāv iva /
tena vaiṣṇavabauddhādiśāsanāntaraniṣṭhitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.191]
quick_english: But growth would not be attained in impure higher rite, like those fixed in other doctrines such as Vaiṣṇava and Buddhist.

label: AgMsv_1.192
cite_parts:
yathā samyaṅ na mucyante na tathā śaivasaṃskṛtāḥ /
atimārgakramakulatrikasrotontarādiṣu // [AgMsv_1.192]
quick_english: As others are not properly liberated, so Śaiva-purified ones are not; they are in streams beyond path, order, triad, and others.

label: AgMsv_1.193
cite_parts:
parameśānaśāstre tu ye samyag dīkṣitā narāḥ /
teṣāṃ naivāpavargasya lābhe bhedo 'sti kaś cana // [AgMsv_1.193]
quick_english: But for men properly initiated in the supreme lord's scripture, there is no difference at all in obtaining liberation.

label: AgMsv_1.194
cite_parts:
na caitadatirikto 'pi mokṣopāyo 'sti kaś cana /
kevalaṃ kvāpy anāyāsāj jīvanmuktikrameṇa ca // [AgMsv_1.194]
quick_english: Nor is there any means of liberation beyond this; only somewhere by effortless living-liberation order.

label: AgMsv_1.195
cite_parts:
śīghram eva parā siddhir yathāsmaddarśaneṣv iti /
kvāpi tattvāvalīyogaparipāṭīkramāc cirāt // [AgMsv_1.195]
quick_english: Supreme accomplishment is indeed quick, as in our views; but somewhere, by the order of truth-series yoga, it comes only after long time.

label: AgMsv_1.196
cite_parts:
tais taiḥ kriyākalāpaiś ca labhyate paramaṃ phalam /
ata evāsti saṃhāradṛśām kauliky apīha dṛk // [AgMsv_1.196]
quick_english: By those ritual parts the supreme fruit is obtained; therefore even here there is a kaulika view for destruction-seers.

label: AgMsv_1.197
cite_parts:
yathoktaṃ kālapādādau dīkṣayec chvapacān iti /
cidunmeṣādikāḥ pañca yāḥ pūrvaṃ prāgabhedataḥ // [AgMsv_1.197]
quick_english: As stated, one should initiate dog-cookers at the beginning of time; the five consciousness-unfoldings formerly existed before difference.

label: AgMsv_1.198
cite_parts:
proktāḥ parasmiṃś cinnāthe bhairave samavāyataḥ /
tā eva bhāvopādhyaṃśalabdhabhedavibhāvitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.198]
quick_english: Declared in supreme Bhairava by union, those powers are differentiated through parts of being-limitation.

label: AgMsv_1.199
cite_parts:
bhedāṃśam eva puṣṇanti prāgabhedajuṣo 'py alam /
tathā hy odanasaṃbhogo yo dehasyopacāyakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.199]
quick_english: The difference-part alone is nourished, even by those enjoying before difference; thus rice-enjoyment nourishes the body.

label: AgMsv_1.200
cite_parts:
kaphasaṃcayapātena sa dehasyāpacāyakaḥ /
nanu devasya viśvātmābhede 'pi svāparicyuteḥ // [AgMsv_1.200]
quick_english: By phlegm accumulation that depletes the body; but even in god's world-self nondifference, from one's own fall.

label: AgMsv_1.201
cite_parts:
vikāriṣv eva yogyānām upādhīnāṃ gatiḥ kutaḥ /
tadupādhivaśād bhedo bhairave bhāvasaṃbhavāt // [AgMsv_1.201]
quick_english: Whence movement of capable limitations among changing things? Difference in Bhairava arises from being through that limitation-control.

label: AgMsv_1.202
cite_parts:
iti nāsmanmanobhūmāv upāroḍhum ivārhati /
tūṣṇīṃ vikāriṇo bhāvāḥ santīti hy atisāhasam // [AgMsv_1.202]
quick_english: Thus it is not fitting to ascend our mind-ground; to say changing beings exist silently is indeed rashness.

label: AgMsv_1.203
cite_parts:
devaḥ sa eva viśvātmā tathārūpeṇa bhāsate /
anupādher abhinnasya bhinnam aupādhibhāsanam // [AgMsv_1.203]
quick_english: That god is indeed world-self and appears in such form; the undivided without limitation has divided limitation-appearance.

label: AgMsv_1.204
cite_parts:
nanv itthaṃ tad asatyaṃ syāt kathaṃ satyaṃ tad eva hi /
tathāvabhāsanād anyat kva kiṃ satyaṃ nirūpyatām // [AgMsv_1.204]
quick_english: But thus that would be unreal; how is that very thing real? From such appearance, where is another real thing to be determined?

label: AgMsv_1.205
cite_parts:
nanv evaṃ svapnasaṃsāraḥ kiṃ satyaṃ kiṃtv asau kila /
abhīṣṭārthakriyāvandhyo 'satyo vyavahṛtaḥ param // [AgMsv_1.205]
quick_english: But thus is dream-world-cycle real? That indeed is devoid of desired action, unreal, yet conventionally used supremely.

label: AgMsv_1.206
cite_parts:
etac cāgre prapañcena yuktiyuktaṃ nirūpyate /
tasmād unmeṣaśaktir yā pūrvam āsīd abhedinī // [AgMsv_1.206]
quick_english: This is determined in detail ahead; therefore the unfolding power that was formerly undivided.

label: AgMsv_1.207
cite_parts:
bhāvonmeṣasvarūpāsau yātā tatpuruṣasthitim /
yad abhinnaṃ tad agrāhyaṃ yac ca grāhakam īśvaram // [AgMsv_1.207]
quick_english: That being-unfolding nature has gone to that-person state; what is undivided is ungraspable, and what is grasping is the lord.

label: AgMsv_1.208
cite_parts:
adhunā tat sthitaṃ grāhyaṃ bhedāt tadgrāhakaṃ bhidaḥ /
puruṣākhyaṃ tataḥ proktaṃ sṛṣṭeḥ prārambhayogataḥ // [AgMsv_1.208]
quick_english: Now that standing is graspable from difference, its grasper of difference; called person, then declared from creation's beginning union.

label: AgMsv_1.209
cite_parts:
susphuṭapratyabhijñānān mukhyaṃ vaktraṃ ca bhaṇyate /
ata evātra visarabhāvasthitivighātakam // [AgMsv_1.209]
quick_english: From clear recognition the chief face is spoken; therefore here it destroys dispersion-being-state.

label: AgMsv_1.210
cite_parts:
nānāruggrahasaṃghātaviṣādi paricarcyate /
anekayuktidalitavyādhisaṃśāntasusthitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.210]
quick_english: Various disease-grasp aggregates and poisons are treated; many reasons split disease, calming and well-establishing.

label: AgMsv_1.211
cite_parts:
atra susphuṭatāṃ yānti bhāvā bhedaikavṛttayaḥ /
bhāvatvam eva yat sarvaṃ tat tv idaṃ pūrvajaṃ mukham // [AgMsv_1.211]
quick_english: Here beings that occur only in difference go to clarity; all being-ness indeed is this former-born face.

label: AgMsv_1.212
cite_parts:
sarvataś ca guṇotkarṣād īśānasyordhvavaktratā /
dikkālakalanāśūnye na tu digbhedakalpanāḥ // [AgMsv_1.212]
quick_english: From all and from excellence-rise, Ishana's upward-face-ness; in space-time-calculation void, not direction-difference imaginations.

label: AgMsv_1.213
cite_parts:
yo hi yasmād guṇotkṛṣṭa iti cordhvo bhaviṣyati /
tato bhāvān yadā samyag icchatīcchāvibhūtitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.213]
quick_english: Who indeed from which excellence-surpassing, thus upward will be; then beings when properly from desire-power.

label: AgMsv_1.214
cite_parts:
tadecchāyāṃ samārūḍhāḥ sā cecchā caiva nirmalā /
yena tanmayatāyogāt saṃvidaikyaṃ spṛśanty amī // [AgMsv_1.214]
quick_english: Ascended in that desire; if that desire is pure, by which through identity-union these touch consciousness-unity.

label: AgMsv_1.215
cite_parts:
kiṃtūpādhyuparaktecchāsaṃchādanatirohitāḥ /
te tadānīṃ sthitā bhāvā devas tu svaiṣaṇāsthitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.215]
quick_english: But beings hidden by limitation-superior desire-covering; then those beings stand, but god stands in own desire.

label: AgMsv_1.216
cite_parts:
parācīnitasaṃvittivaktro na ca parāṃ sthitim /
pūrṇām adhyuṣitas tena suṣupta iva bhāsate // [AgMsv_1.216]
quick_english: One who knows only outer consciousness does not dwell in the supreme full state, so he appears as if in deep sleep.

label: AgMsv_1.217
cite_parts:
asuptaś ca prabuddhatvāt tasya svāpo nimīlanam /
na hy asti paramārthena bhairavānandasaṃvidaḥ // [AgMsv_1.217]
quick_english: He is not truly asleep, for his sleep is only a closing; ultimate Bhairava-bliss consciousness never sleeps.

label: AgMsv_1.218
cite_parts:
tasmin paraprakāśe hi nimīlattvam upāgate /
pralayāt tannimīlattvamitir vā kutra bhāsatām // [AgMsv_1.218]
quick_english: When supreme light is present, where could closing shine except as its own measure?

label: AgMsv_1.219
cite_parts:
anābhātaṃ ca no vastu vyomasadmagavākṣavat /
so 'pi vā kalpitākāraś citprakāśe prakāśate // [AgMsv_1.219]
quick_english: No thing is unilluminated; even an imagined form shines in consciousness-light.

label: AgMsv_1.220
cite_parts:
tad amīlita evāyaṃ nimīlann iva tiṣṭhati /
prabhūṇām avikalpyā hi śaktir durghaṭakāriṇām // [AgMsv_1.220]
quick_english: This unblinking reality stands as if closing, for lords have unimaginable power that performs difficult things.

label: AgMsv_1.221
cite_parts:
idaṃ sukhena ghaṭate duḥkhena ghaṭate tv idaṃ /
ity ābhāsanavaicitrye svatantro hi sa eva naḥ // [AgMsv_1.221]
quick_english: Some things happen with ease and some with difficulty; in this variety of appearance, he alone is autonomous.

label: AgMsv_1.222
cite_parts:
tad eva tasya svātantryaṃ śaktir niyatināmikā /
yayā ruddhaḥ paśur jātu svātantryaṃ naiva vindati // [AgMsv_1.222]
quick_english: His autonomy is the power called niyati; by it the bound soul is restrained and never finds autonomy.

label: AgMsv_1.223
cite_parts:
tadapekṣābalāt proktā patyau durghaṭakāritā /
na hi viśvātmanaḥ kiṃ cit sughaṭaṃ vātha durghaṭam // [AgMsv_1.223]
quick_english: Because of dependence on that, difficult action is attributed to the lord; for the self of the universe nothing is easy or difficult.

label: AgMsv_1.224
cite_parts:
kiṃ muhur muhur etenāsakṛn nanu nirūpitam /
hantāvismṛtiśīlaṃ tvāṃ praty etat syād apārthakam // [AgMsv_1.224]
quick_english: Why repeat this again and again when it is already established? Alas, for your forgetful nature, otherwise it would be useless.

label: AgMsv_1.225
cite_parts:
ekam uddiśya kiṃtv etatsaṃrambho na virājate /
kiṃ hy ekāṅkurasaṃpattyai prāvṛṣeṇyāḥ payomucaḥ // [AgMsv_1.225]
quick_english: Effort aimed at one thing does not shine; rainy-season clouds do not arise for the prosperity of a single sprout.

label: AgMsv_1.226
cite_parts:
marmasthānam idaṃ cātra vyutpādyo hi janaḥ sa ca /
vyāpto hṛdbhuvi karmaughakṛṣṭāyāṃ saukumāryataḥ // [AgMsv_1.226]
quick_english: This is the vital spot here; the person to be instructed is pervaded in the heart-ground, drawn by a mass of action, through delicacy.

label: AgMsv_1.227
cite_parts:
māyābījotthitānantavikalpāṅkurakandalaiḥ /
bhedābhimānajanitavācanaucityasevitaiḥ // [AgMsv_1.227]
quick_english: Endless sprouts and shoots rise from the maya seed, served by speech-fitness born of pride in difference.

label: AgMsv_1.228
cite_parts:
yāvad vidyāmahādāvajvālayaiṣā punaḥ punaḥ /
nālabdhā tāvad asyaitad dvaitaṃ rohet punaḥ punaḥ // [AgMsv_1.228]
quick_english: As long as the great forest-fire of knowledge is not obtained, his duality grows again and again.

label: AgMsv_1.229
cite_parts:
tīkṣṇayuktikuṭhāraughaiḥ sadvidyāvahnidīpitaiḥ /
nirbhinno bhedaviṭapī punar naiva prarohati // [AgMsv_1.229]
quick_english: Split by sharp reason-axes kindled by true knowledge fire, the difference-tree never sprouts again.

label: AgMsv_1.230
cite_parts:
evaṃ deve suṣuptāṃśamadhyāsīne sthitā api /
asaddeśīyatāṃ yānti bhāvāḥ śvabhrakapitthavat // [AgMsv_1.230]
quick_english: Even when god is seated in the deep-sleep portion, things go to false locality, like cavity and wood-apple.

label: AgMsv_1.231
cite_parts:
atra tādṛśam eva svaṃ jñānaṃ vairāgyanirbharam /
nirupākhyaṃ nirālambaṃ vyajṛmbhata vibhāgataḥ // [AgMsv_1.231]
quick_english: Here such own knowledge, laden with detachment, indescribable and unsupported, blooms by distinction.

label: AgMsv_1.232
cite_parts:
kapālamālābharaṇāḥ śmaśānapadavāsinaḥ /
asmātparāṅmukhībhūtā bhūtasaṃghātagocarāḥ // [AgMsv_1.232]
quick_english: Those ornamented with skull garlands, dwelling in cremation grounds, and perceiving element aggregates turn away from this.

label: AgMsv_1.233
cite_parts:
bhogyaṃ jugupsāvadhi sarvam eva bhoktā hy ahaṃ kaḥ kila deha eṣaḥ /
carmāsthimātraṃ na ca sāram atra leśāṃśabhāge 'pi kadācid asti // [AgMsv_1.233]
quick_english: All enjoyable reaches the limit of disgust; the enjoyer is I. This body is only skin and bone, with no essence even in the smallest part.

label: AgMsv_1.234
cite_parts:
ittham abhyasyamānās te parāṃ vairāgyasampadam /
pratikṣaṇam upāruhya nimīlanti tadāhatāḥ // [AgMsv_1.234]
quick_english: Thus practicing, they ascend the supreme wealth of detachment every moment and close, struck by that.

label: AgMsv_1.235
cite_parts:
kim etad iti dhāvanti duḥkhe 'pīndriyavṛttayaḥ /
etad evam iti prāyo virajyante sukhād api // [AgMsv_1.235]
quick_english: Even sense-faculties rush toward suffering, yet mostly turn away from pleasure.

tokens.grounds: root dhāv third plural active present
root viraj third plural middle present

label: AgMsv_1.236
cite_parts:
dṛṣṭānuśravikārthaughavaitṛṣṇye vaśatādhiyaḥ /
tatparaṃ puruṣakhyāter guṇavaitṛṣṇyam ity api // [AgMsv_1.236]
quick_english: With controlled mind, desirelessness toward seen and heard objects leads to desirelessness toward guṇas through knowledge of puruṣa.

label: AgMsv_1.237
cite_parts:
nanv akāṇḍe 'pi pṛcchāmaḥ kiṃ cid yadi na kupyate /
* kim akāṇḍe bhedakāṇḍabhedakāṇḍaghaṭāvadhau // [AgMsv_1.237]
quick_english: We ask, even without cause, what happens if anger does not arise, and what of the division-boundary.

tokens.grounds: root pṛcch first plural active present
root kup third singular passive present

label: AgMsv_1.238
cite_parts:
tarhi saṃvid iyaṃ śuddhā svabhāvād eva cet katham /
aśucibhyo 'pi bhogebhyo rasāt spṛhayatetarām // [AgMsv_1.238]
quick_english: If this consciousness is pure by nature, how does it exceedingly desire taste from impure enjoyments?

tokens.grounds: root spṛh third singular active optative

label: AgMsv_1.239
cite_parts:
nanv avismṛtiśīlatvābhimānaḥ kvādhunā gataḥ /
alaṃ vā buddhyupālabdhair uktam apy etad ucyate // [AgMsv_1.239]
quick_english: Where has pride in the habit of non-forgetting gone now? Enough, or even this is said with intellect's reproaches.

tokens.grounds: root vac third singular passive present

label: AgMsv_1.240
cite_parts:
svabhāvād eva saṃvittiḥ prakāśaparamārthikā /
viśvāvabhāsayogena bhātīti hi vipañcitam // [AgMsv_1.240]
quick_english: Consciousness is supremely real and luminous by nature; by union with world-illumination it appears, as explained.

tokens.grounds: root bhā third singular active present plus iti

label: AgMsv_1.241
cite_parts:
ataś ca saṃvido devyā viśvasmin bhāvamaṇḍale /
svātmany evocchalattvaṃ kiṃ khaṇḍanādāyi jāyate // [AgMsv_1.241]
quick_english: Therefore, in the world-circle of the consciousness-goddess, what arises from refutation in her rising within her own self?

tokens.grounds: root jan third singular active present

label: AgMsv_1.242
cite_parts:
yadāpi parameśānaśaktyā bhedo 'vabhāsyate /
tadāpi saṃvid bhāveṣu dhāvatīti vivicyate // [AgMsv_1.242]
quick_english: Even when difference is manifested by the supreme lord's power, consciousness runs in beings and is distinguished.

tokens.grounds: root bhā third singular passive present
root dhāv third singular active present plus iti
root vic third singular passive present

label: AgMsv_1.243
cite_parts:
yathā loṣṭahradajvālāśvāsakumbhaviyatsthitiḥ /
dharāmbudhimahātejaḥsamīrānantakhātmatām // [AgMsv_1.243]
quick_english: As the state of clod, pool, flame, breath, pot, and sky, so earth, ocean, great fire, wind, and infinite sky nature.

label: AgMsv_1.244
cite_parts:
yāty eva mitirūpeyaṃ saṃvit svocchalitā kramāt /
saṃvidrūpasajātīyān bhāvān evānudhāvati // [AgMsv_1.244]
quick_english: This measure-formed consciousness, risen in itself, gradually follows beings of the same consciousness-formed class.

tokens.grounds: root yā third singular active present
root dhāv third singular active present

label: AgMsv_1.245
cite_parts:
nyarūpyata tathā caitat kenāpi parameśinā /
nimnaṃ taḍāgapānīyaṃ kaḥ pravartayituṃ kṣamaḥ // [AgMsv_1.245]
quick_english: Just as this was shaped by some supreme lord, who is able to set low pond-water in motion?

label: AgMsv_1.246
cite_parts:
paripūrṇe punas tasmin pravāhāḥ sarvatomukhāḥ /
nanu kiṃ kāṃś cid evetthaṃ saiṣā svaniyater balāt // [AgMsv_1.246]
quick_english: When that is full, streams flow in every direction; indeed, what and which ones flow thus by the force of their own nature?

label: AgMsv_1.247
cite_parts:
itthaṃ dhāvati tac cāsyā rāgatattvātmakaṃ vapuḥ /
tatrāpi ca tathā rāgābhāsa eva sa dhāryatām // [AgMsv_1.247]
quick_english: Thus that runs, and her body is the essence of attachment; there too only a reflection of attachment should be held.

label: AgMsv_1.248
cite_parts:
cidātmani tu rāgo 'stu ko 'py anyārūṣaṇātmakaḥ /
nanv itthaṃ cet kathaṃ nāma sā kutrāpi virajyate // [AgMsv_1.248]
quick_english: But let attachment exist in the conscious self, even of another color; if so, how indeed can she become detached anywhere?

label: AgMsv_1.249
cite_parts:
hanta prakṛta evāyaṃ vādaḥ saṃgatim āgataḥ /
yadā hi citir evaiṣā sarvataḥ saṃkucatsthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.249]
quick_english: Alas, this original argument has reached agreement: when consciousness itself is in a contracted state everywhere.

label: AgMsv_1.250
cite_parts:
krameṇa bhogopāyebhyo bhogyebhyo dehato bhujaḥ /
bhogād bhoktus tathā śūnyā mahāpralayabhāg iva // [AgMsv_1.250]
quick_english: Gradually from means of enjoyment, objects, and body, the enjoyer becomes empty like a part of great dissolution.

label: AgMsv_1.251
cite_parts:
jāyate rudrarūpaiṣā daśā sāṃhārikī yataḥ /
sadyojātaś ca yad rudraḥ puruṣaś ceśvarātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.251]
quick_english: This destructive state arises in Rudra form because Sadyojata, Rudra, and Purusha are lord-natured.

label: AgMsv_1.252
cite_parts:
śrīmān sadāśivo deva īśānaś ceti gīyate /
viṣṇur vāmaḥ kajy aghora iti caitad bhaviṣyati // [AgMsv_1.252]
quick_english: Glorious Sadashiva, Deva, and Ishana are sung; Vishnu, Vama, Kajy, and Aghora will also be.

label: AgMsv_1.253
cite_parts:
antaḥsthasarvaśaktitvenaikaikasyāpi bṛṃhaṇāt /
brahmāṇy etāni kathyante bṛhattvād viśvabṛṃhaṇāt // [AgMsv_1.253]
quick_english: Because each has all power within, these Brahmas are called so by expansion, greatness, and universal expansion.

label: AgMsv_1.254
cite_parts:
tadanyaśaktyudrekāṃśe hy ata eva vivakṣite /
pratyekam asti brahmādihetupañcakayogitā // [AgMsv_1.254]
quick_english: Indeed, when other power is in excess and intended, each has a five-cause union.

label: AgMsv_1.255
cite_parts:
saiva śāstreṣu bhedena teṣu teṣu pratanyate /
ataś ca sadyojāte 'smin mukhyā raudradaśā sthitā // [AgMsv_1.255]
quick_english: That same power spreads distinctly in scriptures; therefore the primary fierce state stands in sadyojata.

label: AgMsv_1.256
cite_parts:
sā ca saṃkocarūpāpi cidvikāse bhaviṣyati /
yallīnau brahmaviṣṇvaṃśau tenādhaḥkurute balāt // [AgMsv_1.256]
quick_english: Even in contracted form it will be in consciousness expansion; the absorbed brahma and vishnu parts are forcibly lowered.

label: AgMsv_1.257
cite_parts:
vastvabhāvamayītyādidaśā rudrādhidevatā /
bhinnaprameyeti śrīmadutpalena nyarūpyata // [AgMsv_1.257]
quick_english: The state of absence of thing is the rudra presiding deity; it was described as a distinct object by Srimad Utpala.

label: AgMsv_1.258
cite_parts:
jāto 'pi bhedatanmātre saṃkocaṃ yad upāgataḥ /
tato vyatinimīlete bhoktṛbhogyāv iha sphuṭam // [AgMsv_1.258]
quick_english: Even when born in mere distinction, contraction is approached; then enjoyer and enjoyed are clearly exchanged here.

label: AgMsv_1.259
cite_parts:
ajātam iva tad viśvam atra sadyo 'vabhāsate /
sadyojātapadaṃ tena śūnyasaṃvedanātmakam // [AgMsv_1.259]
quick_english: That universe appears here immediately as if unborn; therefore the sadyojata term is of empty consciousness nature.

label: AgMsv_1.260
cite_parts:
tataḥ śūnyapadasyāntar yāvat sa ca vivikṣati /
devas tāvat svayaṃ bodhe viśvaṃ procchalati sthitam // [AgMsv_1.260]
quick_english: As long as he wishes to distinguish within the empty term, the god himself makes the universe rise, standing in awareness.

label: AgMsv_1.259
cite_parts:
jānāti seyaṃ nāthasya jñānaśaktir vikāsinī /
tayor vikāsiciddhāmni līnatvam upapāditam // [AgMsv_1.259]
quick_english: This expanding knowledge-power of the lord knows; absorption in the expanded consciousness abode is established for those two.

label: AgMsv_1.262
cite_parts:
saṃvidaḥ śūnyarūpāyā vikāso viśvam eva tat /
tathā hi ghanasauṣuptaviśrāntivaśanirbharaḥ // [AgMsv_1.262]
quick_english: The expansion of empty-form consciousness is indeed the universe; for it is full of deep sleep rest.

label: AgMsv_1.263
cite_parts:
tāṃs tān gṛhāpaṇādyaṃśān vetti svapnapadābhidhān /
ata eva na sā sṛṣṭiḥ sthitir eva tu sā tathā // [AgMsv_1.263]
quick_english: Those house and shop parts called dream state are known; therefore that is not creation but maintenance.

label: AgMsv_1.264
cite_parts:
pūrvasṛṣṭeṣu bhāveṣu tad dhi vijñānamātrakam /
tathā ca jāgrato rūpāt svapno bhedena jāyate // [AgMsv_1.264]
quick_english: In previously created beings that is indeed mere consciousness; thus dream arises by distinction from waking form.

label: AgMsv_1.265
cite_parts:
kiṃtu jāgratpadādīnāṃ pratyekaṃ bahubhedatā /
nirṇeṣyate tato yuktaṃ sṛṣṭirūpeṇa bhāsanam // [AgMsv_1.265]
quick_english: But the waking state and the others each have many divisions, which will be determined later; therefore it is fitting that their shining forth takes the form of emanation.

tokens.grounds: adverb of consequence; sandhi form of tataḥ

label: AgMsv_1.266
cite_parts:
ato nijavibodhena tān bhāvān vyāpnuvan vibhuḥ /
etais tyājayate tāṃ svām audāsīnyadaśāṃ vibhuḥ // [AgMsv_1.266]
quick_english: Therefore, pervading those entities by his own awareness, the Lord causes that state of indifference of his to be abandoned through them.

tokens.grounds: adverb of consequence; sandhi form of ataḥ

label: AgMsv_1.267
cite_parts:
jñānaśakter iyaṃ jṛmbhā tajjñānasthitibhāvinaḥ /
bhāvāḥ prayānti pūrṇatvaṃ vikāsinijatejasaḥ // [AgMsv_1.267]
quick_english: This is the expansion of the power of knowledge: entities abiding in the state of that knowledge attain fullness, with their own radiance unfolding.

label: AgMsv_1.268
cite_parts:
paramaḥ khalu saṃkocaḥ sadyojātapade bhavet /
yad eṣāṃ svasvarūpasya niṣṭhā naiva sma jāyate // [AgMsv_1.268]
quick_english: At the level of Sadyojāta there would indeed be supreme contraction, because firm abiding in their own nature does not arise for them.

label: AgMsv_1.269
cite_parts:
vinā saṃvidupārohaṃ sattāsattā jaḍo 'jaḍaḥ /
anīlaṃ nīlam ityādivyavasthā kalpatāṃ katham // [AgMsv_1.269]
quick_english: Without rising into consciousness, how could distinctions like existence and nonexistence, inert and non-inert, or blue and non-blue ever be established?

tokens.grounds: negated quality; sandhi elision marked by apostrophe

label: AgMsv_1.270
cite_parts:
yad uvācotpalagurur yathā sadasatāṃ tathā /
jaḍājaḍānāṃ na svātmaviśeṣa iti niścitam // [AgMsv_1.270]
quick_english: As Utpalaguru said, just as the existent and the nonexistent have no intrinsic difference in their own nature, so too the inert and the non-inert do not; this is firmly established.

tokens.grounds: compound: spoke + Utpalaguru; sandhi fusion in form

label: AgMsv_1.271
cite_parts:
tasmād bodhabharollāsavisṛṣṭasvaparasthitim /
cidanuprāṇanāṃ viṣvag vamann ānandasundarām // [AgMsv_1.271]
quick_english: Therefore, consciousness, in the fullness of its awareness, releases the states of self and other, and everywhere emits an animation of consciousness that is beautiful with bliss.

tokens.grounds: long compound: awareness-fullness + blossoming + emitted + own-other + state

label: AgMsv_1.272
cite_parts:
cidekavapuṣā viśvaṃ svīcikīrṣaṃś cidātmani /
svabodhaśaktivamanāt sa devo vāma ucyate // [AgMsv_1.272]
quick_english: That God, whose one body is consciousness, desiring to make the universe his own within the self of consciousness by emitting his own power of awareness, is called Vāma.

tokens.grounds: compound: consciousness + one + body; instrumental manner
object desired to be made own
compound: consciousness + self; locus of emission
name of the deity in this aspect

label: AgMsv_1.273
cite_parts:
svabodhaśaktyudrekeṇa yady apy eṣa prayacchati /
bhāvānāṃ svavapus tādṛk tathāpi paramārthataḥ // [AgMsv_1.273]
quick_english: Although, by the surge of his own power of awareness, this deity bestows such a form upon beings, nevertheless, in ultimate truth, the matter stands otherwise.

tokens.grounds: compound: own-awareness + power + surge; instrumental cause
first part of concessive; sandhi before apy
second part of concessive with yady
act of granting form to beings

label: AgMsv_1.274
cite_parts:
svīkartum icchan saṃhāram eṣāṃ kalpayate bhidaḥ /
ato bhedavyavasthāyāṃ vāmo 'sau parameśvaraḥ // [AgMsv_1.274]
quick_english: Desiring to take back these beings into himself, he constructs their divisions; therefore, in the arrangement of difference, this supreme lord is called Vāma.

tokens.grounds: refers to the beings or distinctions
compound: difference + arrangement; locus of the name
name of the supreme lord in this function
demonstrative; sandhi elision marked by apostrophe

label: AgMsv_1.275
cite_parts:
atra saubhāgyaniḥṣyandi tādṛg jñānaṃ pratāyate /
saubhāgyaṃ socyate teṣāṃ bhinnānāṃ svīkriyaiva yā // [AgMsv_1.275]
quick_english: Here such knowledge spreads; fortune is called the acceptance of distinct beings.

label: AgMsv_1.276
cite_parts:
bhāvānāṃ ca vicitrāṇāṃ bhogāṅgānāṃ svaśaktitaḥ /
svakautukakalālokād ucchalanty eva yā citiḥ // [AgMsv_1.276]
quick_english: Consciousness springs up from its own power and playful glimpse among varied beings.

label: AgMsv_1.277
cite_parts:
saiva svabhāvarāgeṇa viśvaṃ rañjayate yataḥ /
vyakto hi rañjayed viśvaṃ vyaktiś cāsya svarūpataḥ // [AgMsv_1.277]
quick_english: That same consciousness colors the universe by nature, since manifestation is its own form.

label: AgMsv_1.278
cite_parts:
yaiva procchalitāvasthā svīkārecchābharodayaḥ /
tadraśmisārasarvasve kṣaṇaṃ tiṣṭhaty ananyadhīḥ // [AgMsv_1.278]
quick_english: The risen state of acceptance-desire stands for a moment in ray-essence wealth with undivided mind.

label: AgMsv_1.279
cite_parts:
kiṃ nākarṣati kiṃ naiṣa ca bhāvayati yogavit /
tata evocyate śāstre nārakto rañjayed iti // [AgMsv_1.279]
quick_english: What does the yoga-knower not attract or manifest? Scripture says the uncolored does not color.

label: AgMsv_1.280
cite_parts:
kāmasthaṃ kāmamadhyasthaṃ kāmāṅkuśapuṭīkṛtam /
kāmena sādhayet kāmān kāmaṃ kāmeṣu yojayet // [AgMsv_1.280]
quick_english: Desire, placed and goad-enclosed, should accomplish desires and yoke them into desires.

label: AgMsv_1.281
cite_parts:
kāmaḥ svīkartum icchaiva tadācchādanayogataḥ /
viśvaṃ sādhayate kāmī kāmatattvam idaṃ yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.281]
quick_english: Desire is acceptance-desire; by covering union the desirer accomplishes the universe, because this is desire-principle.

label: AgMsv_1.282
cite_parts:
tathā hi parame svātmany adhyāsya sthairyam añjasā /
taducchalitasaṃbodhakalāsaṃchādanakramāt // [AgMsv_1.282]
quick_english: Thus in the supreme self, steadiness is directly superimposed through the covering order of risen awareness.

label: AgMsv_1.283
cite_parts:
viśvaṃ kāmāṅkuśādhīnaṃ kiṃkaratvena bhāsate /
adhyātmasiddhayā yuktyā tv anayaiva nijodaye // [AgMsv_1.283]
quick_english: The universe appears as servant under the desire-goad; by inner accomplishment method, this is understood in its own rise.

label: AgMsv_1.284
cite_parts:
prāṇaḥ puryaṣṭakaṃ dehaṃ vyāpya viśvaṃ prakarṣati /
tattvasya kāmatattvasya prakaṭīkriyayā yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.284]
quick_english: Life-force pervades body and eightfold city, drawing the universe because desire-principle manifests.

label: AgMsv_1.285
cite_parts:
siddhacakreṣv idaṃ gopyaṃ kiṃ vā na prakaṭīkṛtam /
śūnyānandāt prasṛtyaiva devaḥ procchalitātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.285]
quick_english: Whether this secret is manifested in siddha circles, god spreads from void-bliss as risen-natured.

label: AgMsv_1.286
cite_parts:
vartamāno nijāḥ śaktīr vikāsyaiva pravartate /
yatrāsya pravivikṣāsti yataś ca prāvṛtad vibhuḥ // [AgMsv_1.286]
quick_english: Present, the lord proceeds by unfolding his own powers where he desires to enter, because the lord is covered.

label: AgMsv_1.287
cite_parts:
sarvāḥ śaktīr asau bhāvaḥ svātmany udrecya vartate /
tataś cidātmako devo nyagbhūta iva bhāsate // [AgMsv_1.287]
quick_english: That being remains after raising all powers in itself; then the consciousness-natured god appears as if submerged.

label: AgMsv_1.288
cite_parts:
udbhūtās tu vibhānty etāḥ pronmeṣecchāvidikriyāḥ /
ataś catuṣkayukto 'sau yady api pratibhāsate // [AgMsv_1.288]
quick_english: These arisen powers shine as opening, desire, knowledge, and action; therefore that being appears even though endowed with four.

label: AgMsv_1.289
cite_parts:
tathāpi śaktigaṇanā vastuto 'sya bhavet kutaḥ /
atraiva bhāvabhedāṃśanirmūlanakalā yataḥ // [AgMsv_1.289]
quick_english: Nevertheless, how could power-counting be real for it? Here only the art of uprooting parts of being-difference exists.

label: AgMsv_1.290
cite_parts:
sthitas tataḥ samācāro lokātikrāntagocaraḥ /
anantaśaktivaicitryād atrāpy uccāṭanādayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.290]
quick_english: Then conduct standing beyond world range occurs; from infinite power variety, uprooting and similar acts occur here too.

label: AgMsv_1.291
cite_parts:
saṃhāralīlābhūyiṣṭhā api tās tāḥ kriyāḥ sthitāḥ /
tad itthaṃ jñānaśaktyante bhāvānāṃ vapuṣi sthite // [AgMsv_1.291]
quick_english: Even dissolution-play-predominant actions are established thus at the end of knowledge-power, with beings' body established.

label: AgMsv_1.292
cite_parts:
kriyāśaktir athāntyaiva tān saṃharati sādaram /
yathā sūkṣmatamā śaktir unmeṣākhyā parāvadhau // [AgMsv_1.292]
quick_english: Then final action-power respectfully withdraws them, as the most subtle power called opening at the supreme limit.

label: AgMsv_1.293
cite_parts:
sraṣṭavyabhāvasthaulyena sthūlākāreva bhāsate /
tathaivaiṣā kriyāśaktir yasyāṃ bhāvā nimeṣitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.293]
quick_english: By created being grossness it appears as gross form; thus this action-power is that in which beings are closed.

label: AgMsv_1.294
cite_parts:
svasvarūpasthitā kāpi pūrṇeva pravijṛmbhate /
nanv asty eva kriyā yasyāṃ bhedaḥ pratyavabhāsate // [AgMsv_1.294]
quick_english: Some power established in its own form unfolds as if full; indeed there is action in which difference appears.

label: AgMsv_1.295
cite_parts:
maivaṃ sarvā kriyā bhedaṃ praty uta prāg vyapohati /
tathā hi bhedabhūmau ye kāṣṭhajvalanataṇḍulāḥ // [AgMsv_1.295]
quick_english: Not so: every action does not remove difference beforehand; thus on the ground of difference stand wood, fire, and rice.

label: AgMsv_1.296
cite_parts:
ta eva pākāviṣṭatve bhedaṃ projjhanti sādaram /
yadi bhinnasvarūpās te pākaikyaṃ tat kathaṃ bhavet // [AgMsv_1.296]
quick_english: Those very things abandon difference in the state of cooking; if their natures were different, how could cooking unity arise?

label: AgMsv_1.297
cite_parts:
bhinnaṃ svarūpam aṅgānāṃ na hi yuktyopapadyate /
nanu pāko na kaś cit sa yat tan nānāsvarūpakam // [AgMsv_1.297]
quick_english: A different own-form of the parts is not reasonable; indeed cooking is not any thing that is many-formed.

label: AgMsv_1.298
cite_parts:
jvalanakledadāhādi tat pāka iti śabdyate /
bhinnā eva kriyāḥ sarvāḥ phalam ekaṃ prati sthitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.298]
quick_english: Burning, moistening, burning and so on is called cooking; all different actions are established toward one fruit.

label: AgMsv_1.299
cite_parts:
pāka ity ucyate nānyā kriyā nāmāsti kācana /
etad eva kathaṃ bahvya ekaṃ phalam abhīpsitam // [AgMsv_1.299]
quick_english: Cooking is said; no other action by name exists. How can many yield one desired fruit?

label: AgMsv_1.300
cite_parts:
kathaṃ saṃpādayeyus tāḥ. pūrvoktād eva hetutaḥ /
nanu locanadīpārthamanaskārair api sphuṭam // [AgMsv_1.300]
quick_english: How would those accomplish it from the previously stated cause? Indeed, by eye, lamp, meaning, and mind-efforts, it is clearly so.

label: AgMsv_1.301
cite_parts:
janyate jñānam ekaṃ tat tathaivātra bhaviṣyati /
so 'yaṃ kardamasaṃmardamalinībhūtavigrahaḥ // [AgMsv_1.301]
quick_english: One knowledge is born; so here it will be. That is this body become dirty through kneading mud.
